name: Brasserie by Chef Aless

evidence.note: Guide site says live jazz and DJ music add energy and encourage dancing and mingling (not the venue's own words).
Listing for a New Orleans jazz band's first show here; that band also plays swing dance events.
Restaurant's events page lists dinners and private parties; no dance nights are posted.

dancing.notes: This is mainly a sit-down restaurant. It books jazz bands, including a swing band, but we found no clear sign of a dance floor. Ask before you go if you want to dance.

description: A French brasserie on Merrick Road in Massapequa with a Paris-style dining room and bar. It hosts live jazz and DJ nights.
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Could not confirm the Oct 3 NY Ska Jazz Ensemble show on the restaurant's site. The phone number has a 585 area code but is the one the restaurant publishes. No Facebook page found (Instagram: @brasseriebychefaless).

Directory research 2026-10-04: Live jazz dinners appear on event listing sites (e.g. Paumanok Stompers on Oct 17, 2026) but not on the restaurant's own Events page, which currently only shows a Thanksgiving menu; we did not confirm DJ nights. The 585 phone number is the one the restaurant itself publishes (and Google shows). No Facebook page linked from the site; no public email (contact form only). Photo URLs are the site's gallery images requested as 1400 px JPEGs. Current description still fits.
hours: Tue-Thu 4-9 PM; Fri-Sat 4-9:30 PM (bar until 11 PM); Sun 3-9 PM; closed Mon
